name: @kanzo-tech/kernel
description: Layer 0 of Kanzo's packages — what four of them each wrote: the one failure (`Problem`, RFC 9457), the one bounded wait (`within`), the read side of an engine (`Queryable`), the dispose symbols and a Performance span (`mark`). Depends on nobody.
//peers: None, and no dependency: the kernel is layer 0, it imports nothing, and `src/kernel.test.ts` asserts both. `problems.bnf` is published beside the code because a server in another language generates its own table from it.
//gauges: One gauge per published entry, and one per tree-shaken import a consumer meets; `scripts/gauges.mjs` (through `.size-limit.mjs`) is what each measures, and every limit's reason — each raise, dated, with its before and after — is a row on /docs/design, *A gauge per entry, and its raises written here*.
